title: ActionView Entry Schema v1
description: Schema for ActionView review entries. External orchestration tools create entries conforming to this schema.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Must be '1' for this version.

id.description: Unique identifier. Auto-generated if not provided.

source.description: Name of the orchestration tool that created this entry.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the entry was created.

title.description: Primary display text shown in the list view.

icon.description: Icon name from the Lucide icon set.

content.description: Ordered list of content blocks rendered in the detail view.

actions.description: Entry-level actions the user can take.

groupId.description: Optional group identifier for related entries (e.g., same CI run, same repo). Entries with the same groupId are displayed together.

groupLabel.description: Display label for the group (e.g., 'CI Run #1847'). Shown as the group header in the UI.

pinned.description: Whether this entry is pinned to the top of the list.

priority.description: Priority for ordering. Higher values appear first.

type.description: Block type that determines rendering. Built-in types: markdown, code, json, table, keyValue, link, section, divider, alert, image, diff, video, gallery, timeline, tabs, stat, file, chart, diagram, beforeAfter. Custom types are rendered by plugins.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for the block. Used as the target key for action outcome markers (survives reordering) and for {{content.ID}} command references. Set it (e.g. a PR comment's draft id) when you want durable per-block state.

editable.description: When true, the dashboard shows an inline editor for this block's text. Edits persist to the entry (capturing the original for diff/revert) and can be referenced from action commands via {{content.self}} / {{content.ID}} — so an edited comment flows into the action that uses it.

body.description: Primary content. Interpretation depends on type.

language.description: Programming language for code/diff block syntax highlighting.

filename.description: Filename displayed above code blocks, also the download name for file blocks.

highlight.description: Line numbers to highlight in code blocks.

showLineNumbers.description: Show line numbers in code blocks. Defaults to true.

wordWrap.description: Soft-wrap long lines in code blocks. Defaults to true.

annotations.description: Per-line annotations on a code block (review-style inline comments).

oldFilename.description: Original filename for diff blocks (left side in split mode).

newFilename.description: New filename for diff blocks (right side in split mode).

rows.description: Row data for table blocks. Each cell may be a plain string or a rich-cell object (link, status, code, copy, badge, markdown, image).

sortable.description: Table headers become click-to-sort. Defaults to false.

filterable.description: Show a filter/search input above the table. Defaults to false.

pairs.description: Key-value pairs for keyValue blocks. Values may be plain strings or rich-cell objects.

content.description: Nested content blocks within a section.

actions.description: Actions scoped to this section or alert.

defaultCollapsed.description: Section starts collapsed. Defaults to false.

badge.description: Badge text rendered next to a section title (e.g. '11 sources', '5 pending').

dismissible.description: Whether alerts can be dismissed by the user (persists in localStorage).

url.description: URL for link, image, video, and file blocks. Image/video blocks accept http(s), data:, and file:// URLs (file:// requires the path to be under fileAccess.allowedRoots in actionview.json).

links.description: Multiple links for link blocks (alternative to single url).

icon.description: Optional icon name (Lucide) for link / file / stat blocks.

caption.description: Optional caption for image / gallery / video / chart / diagram blocks.

maxWidth.description: Maximum thumbnail width in CSS pixels.

timestampUrl.description: URL opened when the image is clicked instead of the lightbox (e.g. YouTube ?t=170).

imageAnnotations.description: Overlay annotations on an image (arrows, boxes, text).

startTime.description: Start time in seconds (video block clipping).

endTime.description: End time in seconds (video block clipping).

poster.description: Optional poster image URL for video blocks.

events.description: Chronological events for a timeline block.

tabs.description: Tab definitions for a tabs block.

sparkline.description: Sparkline data points for stat blocks.

fileSize.description: File size in bytes for file blocks.

mimeType.description: MIME type hint for file blocks.

richCell.description: A table cell or keyValue value. Either a plain string or a typed object.

confirmMessage.description: Confirmation message shown before executing. With parameters, displayed above the input form.

parameters.description: Optional runtime input fields. When non-empty the UI shows an inline form before executing; values are substituted into the command via {{param.NAME}} placeholders.

onSuccess.description: What to do with the entry after the action succeeds.

undoCommand.description: Optional undo command. If set, the UI shows an undo button after action execution.

undoWindowSeconds.description: Seconds the undo option remains available. Falls back to the global default from actionview.json (default 10).

name.description: Identifier referenced in command strings as {{param.NAME}}.

label.description: Human-friendly label shown next to the input.

default.description: Initial value (e.g. an AI's draft comment). For numeric/boolean fields, the string is parsed. May itself contain a content reference such as "{{content.self}}" to pre-fill the form from a block's (possibly edited) text.

required.description: If true, a non-empty value must be supplied before execution.

helpText.description: Optional help text shown beneath the input.

url.description: Target URL for HTTP requests. May contain {{param.NAME}} (runtime user input), {{content.self}}/{{content.ID}}/{{entry.FIELD}} (entry data, possibly edited), and {{VAR}} (secrets/env) placeholders. Resolution order: param -> content/entry -> secret.

headers.description: HTTP headers. Values may contain {{param.NAME}}, {{content.*}}/{{entry.*}}, and {{VAR}} placeholders.

body.description: HTTP request body. String leaves may contain {{param.NAME}}, {{content.*}}/{{entry.*}}, and {{VAR}} placeholders; values are JSON-escaped on substitution.

program.description: Program/executable to run for CLI commands. Supports the same placeholders.

args.description: Arguments for CLI commands. Each arg supports {{param.NAME}}, {{content.*}}/{{entry.*}}, and {{VAR}} placeholders; each is passed as a single argv element (no shell quoting).
